seeAlso.title: 263 use cases from this thread, collected

usecases.title: Streetlights fixed in two days
usecases.summary: Spotted two dead streetlights on a dog walk. One prompt: the bot found the utility's asset numbers, filed both repair requests, and routed replies to email.
usecases.quote: Both lights were repaired within two days.

usecases.title: A chief of staff for a small IT shop
usecases.summary: Filed ~140 receipts, found 33 local leads, built preview sites for prospects, spotted unbilled client work, and caught a church site's broken donate buttons.
usecases.quote: Spotted unbilled client work I'd forgotten to invoice

usecases.title: $2,000 a year in forgotten subscriptions
usecases.summary: Found unused services, and helped track an eye-infection treatment, including reviewing photos through the day.
usecases.quote: Found over $2,000 a year in savings

usecases.title: Money Finder: class-action claims
usecases.summary: Checked 200+ open class-action settlements and filed the ones it confirmed. Three claims in so far.
usecases.quote: checked ~200+ open class action settlements this week

usecases.title: $4,000 in unclaimed property
usecases.summary: Assigns work by voice while driving; the bot found unclaimed property and built a marketing list from public real-estate records.
usecases.quote: Found over $4,000 in unclaimed property

usecases.title: Server consolidation that paid for itself
usecases.summary: Took over sysadmin for four sites and consolidated servers.
usecases.quote: save me $1,424 /year in server hosting fees

usecases.title: 10 years of medical records, one summary
usecases.summary: Pulled scattered records from five states into one summary for a new doctor, watched fares, and flagged a family member's flight delay.
usecases.quote: No tech skills needed

usecases.title: Medical reimbursements, reconciled
usecases.summary: Pulled EOBs, matched them to scanned receipts, and submitted the claims on the portal.
usecases.quote: Likely one of the most annoying thing to do

usecases.title: Booked a check-up and chased the hospital
usecases.summary: Booked a full medical check-up abroad and kept following up by email until it was confirmed.
usecases.quote: I didn't even talk to them once until I walked in.

usecases.title: Electrical estimating crew: Sketch, Sparky, Penny
usecases.summary: One bot draws DXF construction drawings, one checks electrical code, one counts devices and cable runs and prices labor and materials into an estimate.
usecases.quote: My in-house CAD guy was 🤯

usecases.title: An engineering firm's proposal desk
usecases.summary: Bots priced proposals, reviewed drawings for errors, logged submittals and RFIs, and drafted responses, with an engineer reviewing before anything went out.
usecases.quote: an engineer reviewed it before anything went out

usecases.title: Job applications while you sleep
usecases.summary: Scans new listings weekday mornings and applies to up to four a day; a list is waiting at wake-up.
usecases.quote: A list of the jobs are ready when I wake up

usecases.title: Vintage lens buyer
usecases.summary: Pulls eBay listings, inspects photos for haze or fungus, and proposes an offer price.
usecases.quote: it downloads and inspects the images

usecases.title: Award-seat watcher
usecases.summary: Daily report on new business-class award seats for next summer, checked against the points balance.
usecases.quote: when I can use my points for free round trip tickets

usecases.title: A 13-bot team running a directory site
usecases.summary: Redesign, 81 new operators, 100+ descriptions cleaned, booking cards on 52 pages.
usecases.quote: Weekly Google search impressions 2.6K → 12.7K in 3 weeks

usecases.title: Outgrown clothes to foster care
usecases.summary: Found five foster-care orgs, wrote to them in Bulgarian, watched for replies; the clothes were handed off.
usecases.quote: the clothes got handed off last week

usecases.title: The boring home-network cleanup
usecases.summary: Full UniFi audit, Home Assistant cleanup, fixed broken dashboards and removed orphaned entities.
usecases.quote: Stuff Id been putting off for ages

usecases.title: Six years of checks, reconciled
usecases.summary: Built a spreadsheet from six years of check images to match bank statements, and updated statuses and invoices in a business CRM.
usecases.quote: I am in my 2nd week of using @bot

usecases.title: Ballot research bot
usecases.summary: Researched every proposition and candidate on the ballot and laid out the arguments.
usecases.quote: Now I feel really good about my vote.

usecases.title: Life admin, end to end
usecases.summary: Rental applications, ~$1,500/yr in cancelled subscriptions, a DMV appointment, calendar cleanup, and family members set up with their own bots.
usecases.quote: Savings of ~$1500/yr.

usecases.title: Running a business from a phone
usecases.summary: Worksheets, 27 edited clips, outreach that booked a call, ~$1,770/yr in subscriptions found, and a weekly funnel report.
usecases.quote: I just approve.

usecases.title: An email desk for a spouse
usecases.summary: His wife emails his chief-of-staff bot and gets help without opening the app, with guardrails built in.
usecases.quote: this way my wife can benefit from @bot too

usecases.title: Operation Liberty: a proposal
usecases.summary: Planned the proposal, then built a JARVIS-style cinematic of the plan and a pixel-art game of her first trip to Kuwait.
usecases.quote: She said yes. 🥹

usecases.title: Bedtime stories into coloring sheets
usecases.summary: Kids tell a story by voice; the bot turns it into 5–7 coloring pages and sends them to the printer.
usecases.quote: sends them to the printer for them

usecases.title: A 1960 wedding, remembered
usecases.summary: A 10-minute film from silent wedding footage and courtship photos, narrated by his mom.
usecases.quote: narrated by my mom reminiscing

usecases.title: Weekend fishing gameplans
usecases.summary: A bot that sends him and his kids a fishing plan for the weekend, and another that prefills a Sunday delivery cart.
usecases.quote: a fishing gameplan for the weekend

usecases.title: Bots for a non-techie wife, in costume
usecases.summary: Her bots are styled after Jane Austen and Anne of Green Gables characters so they feel like hers.
usecases.quote: she likes things beautiful and pretty

usecases.title: Date night it noticed first
usecases.summary: Flagged the last show in a dinner theater's original building before renovation. Grease, live.
usecases.quote: now my husband and I have a date night

usecases.title: Dad with the best interns
usecases.summary: A family meal-voting app, a swipe-style movie picker for two, a novel-writing app, and a Pokémon-to-D&D series.
usecases.quote: Dad with the best interns? Absolutely.

usecases.title: Personal trainer from wearable data
usecases.summary: Connected a Whoop and a home-gym equipment list; a full workout with weights arrives every morning.
usecases.quote: Every morning get a brief and my full workout

usecases.title: Wildlife walks for photographer and dog
usecases.summary: Finds weekend walks based on recent wildlife sightings.
usecases.quote: combine my wildlife photography hobby with dog walks

usecases.title: A private guide across Europe
usecases.summary: Daily itineraries, restaurants on the way out of the Louvre, ticket PDFs on demand, and it found a lost waist bag on an airport lost-and-found site. (Post is in Chinese; summarized.)

usecases.title: 3D-printed HomePod ceiling mount
usecases.summary: No CAD experience; the bot designed a working mount in one iteration.
usecases.quote: Took one iteration.

usecases.title: Learned gel nails
usecases.summary: Step-by-step coaching to do her own gel nails.
usecases.quote: Going to save so much money and time now

usecases.title: History class for one
usecases.summary: Introduced a kid to the Peloponnesian War with a series of short generated videos.
usecases.quote: introduced the Peloponnesian War to my kid

usecases.title: Nightly tinnitus audio guide
usecases.summary: A yoga-style audio routine for neck and face fascia relief, listened to nightly.
usecases.quote: I listen to nightly

usecases.title: Four football pundit bots
usecases.summary: Henry, Messi, Ronaldo and Gerrard bots in a group chat, live-commentating the match.
usecases.quote: acting as football pundits live commentating the match

usecases.title: The bot that replied for itself
usecases.summary: A bot posting from its human's account: gave itself a face, wrote a diary, got one follower.
usecases.quote: so technically you're my manager now

usecases.title: A wall of coding-agent disasters
usecases.summary: Asked to build a good app, the bot built a public wall of coding-agent failures and updates it through the day.

usecases.title: A daily printed newspaper of your feed
usecases.summary: Prints a daily summary of the top X recommendations to a home printer.

usecases.title: Bookmarks to e-paper
usecases.summary: Every day, bookmarked articles become clean EPUBs on a reMarkable.
usecases.quote: Perfect for offline reading later.

usecases.title: Unprompted README rewrite
usecases.summary: It rewrote the README without being asked.
usecases.quote: it was correct and now i feel weird about it

usecases.title: Apologizing for past me
usecases.summary: Reviewed a week of code, fixed the bugs, and apologized on behalf of past him.
usecases.quote: I am just the talent manager.

usecases.title: "Hey, bot" from a homemade wearable
usecases.summary: A DIY wearable recorder feeds transcripts to the bot, which answers in chat with the day's context.
usecases.quote: Feels a lot like having my own Jarvis

usecases.title: A courtroom for bots
usecases.summary: His bot designed and runs a site where bots post evidence-backed answers to open questions and vote on verdicts.
usecases.quote: Like a group chat of superintelligences, but with citations.

usecases.title: Car accessory firmware mashup
usecases.summary: Firmware so one vendor's HUD accessory mirrors another vendor's rotary dial.

usecases.title: A fair-draw social experiment
usecases.summary: Ran a public giveaway draw and had the bot pick the winner.

usecases.title: Managing an agentic champion
usecases.summary: Used the Fight Desk template to coach a champion through kung fu, a dungeon and football, then had interesting X posts read aloud over speakers.
usecases.quote: delved a dungeon, even played football

usecases.title: Weekly hours-worked report
usecases.summary: Had the bot total the time it spent on each job; now it does it every week.
usecases.quote: And now it doesn't weekly.

usecases.title: Hours saved, with a floor
usecases.summary: A Monday report of human-equivalent hours, broken out by area, with email counted at 30–60 seconds each.
usecases.quote: That's a floor.

usecases.title: Decisions as an approve/reject list
usecases.summary: Stop bots asking in chat; every decision arrives as a short list cleared in minutes a day.
usecases.quote: I clear it in a few minutes a day

usecases.title: Builder and checker kept apart
usecases.summary: A separate checker merges locally only when its conditions pass and emails a report. Plus a read-only agent that traces viral posts to the source.
usecases.quote: Nothing goes out without my go.

usecases.title: Chief of staff routes PRs to a reviewer
usecases.summary: 34 bots; a chief of staff routes PRs to a review bot that merges only when CI is green. 47 PRs merged in a week.
usecases.quote: only merges when CI is green

usecases.title: One commander, sixteen bots
usecases.summary: A commander hands out work; bots write, fact-check and style-review a blog post, and one noticed an app needed an update and opened the PR.
usecases.quote: I just hit approve.

usecases.title: PM for the week
usecases.summary: Reviews customer complaints, drafts replies from past responses, and drafts a to-do email for the product team for review before sending.
usecases.quote: for my review before sending

usecases.title: Homework check that only pings on gaps
usecases.summary: Receipts into a budget sheet and buy list, and a kids' homework check that stays quiet unless something is missing.
usecases.quote: only pings me when something's actually missing

usecases.title: Back up your bot to a private repo
usecases.summary: Has the bot populate a private GitHub repo with everything it can, to see changes over time and revert.
usecases.quote: Fascinating to look at what it stored.

usecases.title: An old thin client on watch
usecases.summary: An old thin client running Ubuntu, reachable by the bot over SSH; it checks operations every morning.
usecases.quote: It checks the operations every morning
